familiar_places.name: Palace of Fine Arts, walked there every morning
Old flat on Chestnut St, lived there 30 years

contacts.name: Silver Alert
contacts.note: Police request it through CHP. Call 911 or SFPD and ask them to evaluate a Silver Alert.

notes.text: Walks toward the Palace of Fine Arts when he thinks he is going to work; he was a groundskeeper there
Goes to the Harbor Corner Market for coffee and the newspaper every morning
Looks for his old dog Buddy on the Harbor Green and down the alley
Gets cold fast; usually leaves without a jacket or shoes
Sits on the steps of the corner church on Chestnut when he is upset

description.marks: walks with a slight limp, left leg

diagnosis: Alzheimer's disease, moderate stage; may not answer to his name; may believe he is going to work

doctor.name: Dr. Priya Nair, UCSF Memory and Aging Center
